original: bāhye milanakālam āha | divasam ityādi | pretapakṣaḥ kṛṣṇapakṣaḥ | dhvaja udbaddhaḥ | svamāṃsāsthimajjādibhir api sarvasattvābhilaṣitārthaṃ karīṣyāmīti kṛtapraṇidhir bodhisattva eva nirantarāṇāṃ mānuṣajanmanā (442r/887) saptānām ante ca vartanāt saptajanmā yasya sapta cchāyā bhavanti | sa tābhir lakṣitavyaḥ |
analyzed: bāhye milana kālam āha divasam ityādi preta pakṣaḥ kṛṣṇa pakṣaḥ dhvajaḥ udbaddhaḥ sva māṃsa asthi majja ādibhiḥ api sarva sattva abhilaṣita artham karīṣyāmi iti kṛta praṇidhiḥ bodhisattvaḥ eva nirantarāṇām mānuṣa janmanā saptānām ante ca vartanāt sapta janmāḥ yasya sapta chāyāḥ bhavanti sa tābhiḥ lakṣitavyaḥ

original: svayaṃ yadā mṛtas tadā sa viśeṣato bhakṣayitavya iti śeṣaḥ | naiva mārayitavya iti śiraścālenāha | kṛpām utpādya yatnena | māraṇaṃ kriyata iti | api tu naivety ākūtam | yadā tu sa bodhisattvo yācitaḥ svamāṃsādikaṃ dadāti | tadā yācakānāvadyaṃ sattvapīḍākṛtam | anyathā bodhisattvānāṃ dāna(442v/888)pāramitā na syāt |
analyzed: svayam yadā mṛtaḥ tadā sa viśeṣataḥ bhakṣayitavyaḥ iti śeṣaḥ na eva mārayitavyaḥ iti śiraḥ cālena āha kṛpām utpādya yatnena māraṇam kriyate iti api tu na eva iti ākūtam yadā tu sa bodhisattvaḥ yācitaḥ sva māṃsa ādikam dadāti tadā yācaka anāvadyam sattva pīḍā kṛtam anyathā bodhisattvānām dāna 442v888 pāramitā na syāt

original: yācakajanapāpaśaṅkayā dānābhāvāt | na ca kvacic chrūyate yācakā narakaṃ yānty atra duṣṭāśayebhya iti | atha vā nirayakarmābhimukhān duṣṭān praty āha | kṛpām utpādyetyādi | ata evoktaṃ dvikalpe |
analyzed: yācaka jana pāpa śaṅkayā dāna abhāvāt na ca kvacid śrūyate yācakāḥ narakam yānti atra duṣṭa āśayebhyaḥ iti atha vā niraya karma abhimukhān duṣṭān prati āha kṛpām utpādya ityādi atas eva uktam dvi kalpe

original: % Q/R Hevajratantra (I.vii.22)
analyzed: R

original: duṣṭāvatāreṇa sarvo vidhimukhyāt prasidhyatīti |
analyzed: duṣṭa avatāreṇa sarvaḥ vidhi mukhyāt prasidhyati iti

original: duṣṭānāṃ sanmārgāvatāraṇanimittam | sarva iti na kevalam abhicāro vidveṣā(443r/889)dayo 'pi duṣṭānām avatāraṇārtham eva | mukhyān mukhyavṛttyā punaḥ sarvam idaṃ prati sidhyate | tatra tathā kurvan yogī yadi taṃ sanmārge 'vatārayituṃ śaknoti tadaiva tat kartavyam | anyathainaṃ prati kṛpaivāsya na syād ity āha | kṛpāhīnāhaṃ ityādi |
analyzed: duṣṭānām sat mārga avatāraṇa nimittam sarve iti na kevalam abhicāraḥ duṣṭānām avatāraṇa artham eva mukhyāt mukhya vṛttyā punar sarvam idam prati sidhyate tatra tathā kurvan yogī yadi tam sat mārge vatārayitum śaknoti tadā eva tat kartavyam anyathā enam prati kṛpā eva asya na syāt iti āha kṛpā hīnā aham ityādi

original: ata evālabdhanigrahānugrahasāmarthyānāṃ sarvatantreṣu niṣiddhaṃ māraṇam | tad uktaṃ śrīsamāje |
analyzed: atas eva alabdha nigraha anugraha sāmarthyānām sarva tantreṣu niṣiddham māraṇam tat uktam śrī samāje

original: % Q/R Guhyasamāja (18.92)
analyzed: R Guhyasamāja 1892

original: māraṇaṃ jīvanaṃ caiva traidhātukam aśeṣataḥ |
analyzed: māraṇam jīvanam ca eva traidhātukam aśeṣatas

original: karoti kṣaṇamātreṇa (443v/890) vyaktaśaktir na saṃśaya iti |
analyzed: karoti kṣaṇa mātreṇa vyakta śaktiḥ na saṃśayaḥ iti

original: ata eva cākṣobhyādilokadhātau tadvijñānaṃ nītvaivam anuṣṭhātavyam ity uktam | yad api kvacit simasimāyamānaprāṇisahitavairocanādibhakṣaṇam uktaṃ tatrāpi mṛteṣv iti boddhavyam | tad uktaṃ catuṣpīṭhe |
analyzed: atas eva ca akṣobhya ādi lokadhātau tad vijñānam nītvā evam anuṣṭhātavyam iti uktam yat api kvacid sima simāyamāna prāṇi sahita vairocana ādi bhakṣaṇam uktam tatra api mṛteṣu iti boddhavyam tat uktam catuṣpīṭhe

original: % Q/R Catuṣpīṭha (~4.1.49, = Vajraḍāka 22.)
analyzed: R Co aja aja

original: ahiṃsā jantum ādikaṃ tu kāruṇyāhitacetasaḥ |
analyzed: ahiṃsā jantum ādikam tu kāruṇya āhita cetasaḥ

original: na hi prāṇivadhaḥ kāryo varaṃ mṛtyusamāgama iti |
analyzed: na hi prāṇi vadhaḥ kāryaḥ varam mṛtyu samāgamaḥ iti

original: kṛpāṃ darśayati | yathātmany aham ity ādhimokṣas tathā sattvo 'py aham ity adhimoktavya (444r/891) iti | parātmasamatātra darśitā | na kevalaṃ yā karuṇayaivaṃ kartavyam api tu prajñayāpīty āha | yogātmā śūnyatākaruṇābhinno vajradhara iti ||
analyzed: kṛpām darśayati yathā ātmani aham iti tathā aham iti adhimoktavyaḥ iti parātma samatā atra darśitā na kevalam yā karuṇayā evam kartavyam api tu prajñayā api iti āha yoga ātmā śūnyatā karuṇā bhinnaḥ vajradharaḥ iti

original: āmnāyamañjaryāṃ śrīsaṃpuṭaṭīkāyāṃ saptadaśī mañjarī ||
analyzed: āmnāyamañjaryām śrī saṃpuṭa ṭīkāyām saptadaśī mañjarī
